  APPLICATION OF SOUTHWESTERN ELECTRIC POWER
  COMPANY FOR AUTHORITY TO AMEND TARIFFS FOR
RETAIL ELECTRIC SERVICE TO INCLUDE NEW STANDARD
FORM CONTRACT FOR ELECTRIC SERVICE – LARGE LOAD




                       SOAH ORDER NO. 3
              GRANTING MOTION TO EXTEND DEADLINE

      SOAH Order No. 2 set a deadline for parties to file a joint proposed
procedural schedule. On February 6, 2026, Southwestern Electric Power Company
filed a letter requesting for an extension of the deadline. The motion is
GRANTED and the deadline is extended to February 13, 2026.


Signed February 11, 2026


                                   _____________________________
                                   Rachelle Nicolette Robles,
                                   Administrative Law Judge
